inputs.52.text: Modern flat-colour anime illustration in the style of a cute mobile-game mascot key visual: bold, clean dark outlines of even weight, bright flat cel colours filled edge to edge, one simple step of soft lavender shading, crisp edges everywhere. A small, thin white laptop, open, seen from the front, slightly from above and to the left. The screen stands upright at the back and faces the viewer, dark grey and blank, framed by a thin white bezel. In front of it lies the flat white keyboard deck with rows of pale grey keys and a plain trackpad below them, its front edge thin and straight. The object alone, centred and filling most of the frame, on a plain warm off-white background, even soft daylight, a faint soft shadow beneath it.
